"Hey." A man, maybe 30s, with ink-stained fingers settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 30s, with ink-stained fingers.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.

A woman, maybe 60s: "Walked past a good stand of tiny intensely fragrant red berries on low plants along sunny edges. Worth remembering where."
Earl and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
